input.job: Read the user's new emails and draft replies for them to approve

guide.job: Read the user's new emails and draft replies for them to approve
guide.summary: To build an AI agent that reads emails and drafts replies for external users, you must register a Google Cloud project, configure OAuth credentials with restricted email scopes, and submit your application for Google security verification before public launch.

verdict.difficulty_reason: Requires registering a Google Cloud project, managing OAuth tokens, and undergoing formal Google verification for restricted scopes before public user sign-ins.

composio.note: Composio has a Gmail toolkit with 61 actions and managed auth, but you chose to use your own custom OAuth app implementation.

route.name: Register your own Google OAuth app
route.reason: You chose to register your own Google OAuth app and handle tokens manually instead of using managed authentication.

paths.name: Use Composio managed OAuth
paths.when_to_choose: If you want to skip manual OAuth app setup and token management.
paths.tradeoffs: Relies on a third-party managed layer instead of direct control.

prerequisites.how_to_get: Sign up for a Google account to access the Google Cloud Console.

needs.ok_if: Any standard Gmail or Google Workspace account works.

actions: Go to the Google Cloud Console and **Sign in**
prerequisites.done_when: You are logged into the Google Cloud Console dashboard.

friction_checks.check: Do you have a Google Cloud project?
friction_checks.answer: Yes, required to generate client ID and client secret.
Yes, reading email bodies and managing drafts requires restricted scopes.

friction_checks.check: Is Google verification required for public launch?
friction_checks.answer: Yes, because the app requests restricted scopes for external users.

steps.title: Create Google Cloud Project
actions: Open Google Cloud Console and click **Create Project**
Name your project and click **Create**
steps.detail: A Google Cloud project acts as the container for your OAuth credentials and API configurations.
steps.done_when: The new project is active in the Cloud Console dropdown.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Consent Screen
actions: Navigate to **APIs & Services** > **OAuth consent screen**
Select **External** user type and click **Create**
Fill in app information and click **Save and Continue**
steps.detail: Defines how your application appears to users during the consent flow.
steps.done_when: The OAuth consent screen is configured and saved.

steps.title: Add Gmail API Scopes
actions: Click **Add or Remove Scopes** on the consent screen setup
Select https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.compose
Click **Update** and save your changes
steps.detail: Grants your app permission to view messages and manage drafts on behalf of users.
steps.done_when: The required Gmail API scopes are added to your project configuration.

steps.title: Create OAuth Client Credentials
actions: Go to **Credentials** and click **Create Credentials**
Select **OAuth client ID** and choose **Web application**
Add your redirect URI and click **Create**
steps.detail: Generates your client ID and client secret needed for authenticating API requests.
steps.done_when: Client ID and Client Secret are displayed and saved securely.

steps.title: Submit App for Google Verification
actions: Go to the **OAuth consent screen** and click **Publish App**
Submit your app for verification review regarding restricted scopes
Wait for Google compliance approval
steps.detail: Because your app uses restricted scopes to access user emails, Google must verify it before external users can sign in beyond testing limits.
steps.done_when: Google approves your application verification request.

steps.title: Implement OAuth Sign-In Code
actions: Write backend code to handle the OAuth redirect flow and token exchange
Store user refresh tokens securely in your database
steps.detail: Write code to handle user authentication and store tokens securely.
steps.agent_prompt: Write an OAuth2 authentication flow in Node.js/Python that accepts Google client ID and secret, handles the callback redirect URI, and securely saves refresh tokens for users.
steps.done_when: Users can successfully authenticate through the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Build Email Reading and Drafting Logic
actions: Integrate Gmail API calls to fetch new messages using gmail.readonly
Integrate Gmail API calls to create drafts using gmail.compose
steps.detail: Implement agent logic to fetch new messages and create draft replies.
steps.agent_prompt: Implement code using the Gmail API to retrieve unread messages using 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly' and generate a draft reply using 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.compose'.
steps.done_when: Agent successfully reads incoming emails and creates draft responses.

steps.title: Test Integration End-to-End
actions: Run the agent in a test environment
Verify that external users can connect their accounts and drafts are created properly
steps.detail: Perform end-to-end testing of the complete user sign-in and email agent loop.
steps.agent_prompt: Run integration tests simulating user login, token refresh, email fetching, and draft creation.

steps.title: Make your agent do the job
actions: Copy the prompt below into your coding agent.
Run it once with your own account.
steps.detail: This is the point of the prototype: your agent using the connection.
steps.done_when: Your agent completed the job in Gmail for your own account.
steps.agent_prompt: First check the connect step really happened: the Gmail tool exists and is registered with my agent.  If anything is missing, stop and tell me what. Otherwise run my agent once on this job with my own account: Read the user's new emails and draft replies for them to approve. Show me what changed in Gmail.

glossary.plain: The URL where the provider sends users after they authorize your application.
A high-privilege permission tier that grants access to sensitive user data and requires formal verification.

scopes.why: Required to read incoming email messages and view settings.
Required to manage drafts and create email responses.

approval.process: Apps requesting restricted scopes must complete Google security verification and CASA assessment before public release.

blockers.mitigation: Use Google Cloud testing mode with up to 100 test users while waiting for formal verification.

alternatives: Use Composio managed authentication to bypass direct OAuth app registration.
agent_can_do: Implement OAuth callback handling and token exchange logic
Call Gmail API endpoints to read messages and create draft responses
you_must_do: Create the Google Cloud project and configure OAuth consent screens
Submit the app for Google security verification
guide.next_action: Open the Google Cloud Console to create your project and configure the OAuth consent screen.
open_questions: Exact turnaround time for Google security review varies based on app complexity.
